name: MsoTextFontAlign
description: Indicates the text alignment scheme used for an object.

constants.name: msoFontAlignMixed
constants.description: Specifies that there is a mix of text alignments used with the object.

constants.name: msoFontAlignAuto
constants.description: Specifies that the text alignment will be determined by the Office application.

constants.name: msoFontAlignTop
constants.description: Specifies that the font is aligned to the top of the object.

constants.name: msoFontAlignCenter
constants.description: Specifies that the font is aligned to the center of the object.

constants.name: msoFontAlignBaseline
constants.description: Specifies that the font is aligned to the baseline of the object.

constants.name: msoFontAlignBottom
constants.description: Specifies that the font is aligned to the bottom of the object.
